Step: 1451 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but not by 100 unless divisible by 400; 1451 not divisible by 4).  
76 days = 31 (March) + 30 (April) + 15 (May) backward from 11 July 1451.  
11 July → back 15 days → 26 June.  
Back further 61 days (31+30) from 26 June → 26 April.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1451-04-26
